messages:
Anika: Quick check — model catalog intake status for sable-6b and opal-4.2. Need owners for: 1) licensing follow-up (legal needs SPDX or explicit redistribution clause), 2) perf triage (tail latency >1024 seq), 3) metadata CR review (#4321). Proposed canary window: 2026-03-30 -> 2026-04-03. Who's taking which?

Mike: Happy to take licensing follow-up with Legal. I'll ping @catalog-legal. I need the model_license file from the curation bucket. @Jordan can you share the upload path?

Jordan: Uploading now to s3://redwood-models/curation/new/sable-6b/LICENSE.txt. PR #4321 is ready for review, added model_card and perf_profile. PTAL. Small note: opal perf numbers are in staging-run-238.log

Sana: I'll own perf triage for opal-4.2. Saw 95th pct tail increase at seq 2048 when qkv-fused kernels used. Repro steps in staging: ```python run_perf.py --model opal-4.2 --seq 2048 --batch 4``` Need access to quantized-kernels branch on runtime to test.

Leo-bot: Checklist update: licensing: pending (sable-6b), perf: flagged (opal-4.2), metadata CR: open (#4321). Automated canary slot requested 2026-03-30 00:00 UTC. :robot_face:

Anika: Thanks. Mike -> legal ping. Sana -> I'll add you to the runtime-access group (aws:ssm). Jordan -> can you drop the exact diff snippet for metadata here? small one-liner is fine.

Jordan: Diff: added `model_card.inference.qualities = ['robustness','throughput']`, `quantization.supported = true`. PR link: https://git.redwood.com/curation/pull/4321. Also added license pointer field `license_url`.

Mike: I've pinged @catalog-legal: they'll triage today and asked for source license text + redistrib clause. @Sana I'll give you SSM access in 10.

Sana: Got SSM, running perf job now. Early result: baseline w/ fused kernels: p50 28ms p95 210ms at seq 1024; quantized path p95 260ms. Will post full logs in thread.

Anika: :thumbsup: if we can get legal signoff by 2026-03-25 and perf PR merged by 2026-03-27 we can keep canary window. If blockers appear, fallback plan is to schedule another canary 2026-04-06 -> 2026-04-09. Anyone seeing conflicts?

Jordan: No conflicts from infra side. Will address minor metadata comments today.

Sana: Posting perf gist: https://gist.github.com/sana/perf-opal-4-2-staging. Noting memory pressure spikes when batch>6.

Mike: Legal acknowledged and requested CLA for upstream model author. I'll loop in @catalog-legal and @legal-eng for next steps.

Anika: Great — owners: Mike (licensing), Sana (perf triage), Jordan (metadata + CR), Anika (canary coordination). I'll create a lightweight checklist in the curation repo and update daily here. Thanks all. :eyes:
